defect: handshake data is sampled from an unheld source bus when the synchronized request arrives
rationale: The request toggle is synchronized into clk_b, but data_a is not registered and held in clk_a until the acknowledgement returns.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Toggle request is correctly 2-flop synchronised, but data_a is captured unqualified-by-hold and whether the external source holds it until ack_toggle_b is an unstated environment protocol.

labels.by: gpt-6.1-sol (separate settling reader, the case and both arguments only)
labels.note: The destination captures the unsynchronised bus after the synchronised request, which is correct only if the external source holds data_a through capture; the RTL and constraints neither establish nor contradict that.

provenance.adaptation: Kept the request-toggle, destination synchronizer, data transfer, and acknowledgement shape, reduced assertion and parameter dependencies, and exposed a self-contained top module.

mutation.description: Captured data_a directly at the destination request event without a source-domain holding register and return-side hold contract.
